name: Brise-malin
description:
The Akitsu Yuugei grounds located next to the "Test of Courage."
Players can access a special Akitsu Yuugei game via a mystical doorway leading to a Domain.
Stages in this Domain require you to overcome Boss Bricks. Behold as you encounter satirically designed version of opponents rare and familiar on the board, adding a new flavor to your matches...
